positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst:
DAY NINE. AVALANCHE EXITED ON PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATION #3 (SELL-THE-NEWS), NOT ON BOARD RANK. AVAX is actually FIRST of eight this morning (+0.48% vs midnight Chicago, the only green name) and passes both legs of the two-part test on paper. But yesterday I wrote four structural invalidations that end the position regardless of price, and #3 was: AVAX closes the post-activation session BELOW its pre-activation level. Helicon activated at 15:00 UTC; AVAX sold off from ~11.38 to ~10.53 on the 15-minute chart through the activation (-5.7% intraday) and has recovered to 11.19 — still ~1.7% under the pre-activation ~11.38 print. That is the sell-the-news outcome I named as the strongest argument against the trade. The pre-activation level comes from a narrative source (KuCoin 15m chart write-up), not the canonical feed, so this is a judgment on an unverified number; I am honoring the rule anyway because a rule I only follow when the price source is convenient is not a rule. The exit was profitable: the anticipation dip was bought at 10.905 before the event.

WHY BITCOIN. The tape is broadly RISK-OFF overnight: 7 of 8 names red vs Chicago midnight (AVAX +0.48%, BTC -1.51%, SOL -1.74%, ETH -1.75%, LTC -2.13%, ADA -2.46%, XRP -2.92%, DOGE -3.68%). BTC tagged ~87,165 at midnight and has given back to ~85,830. On a red, low-edge board the mandate says default to the liquid majors, and BTC is SECOND on the board — the best-holding major, losing the least — with a live affirmative catalyst: US spot BTC ETFs took in ~$715M on Sep 22 (third-largest inflow of September, BlackRock-led) inside a ~$3.8B three-week inflow run, the best stretch of 2026. Deepest book in the asset class and the tightest 8% stop tier = the most downside protection available.

positions.risks:
BUYING BACK THE ASSET I ROTATED OUT OF TWO DAYS AGO, ON A RED TAPE. BTC is -1.5% since midnight and pulled back from ~87.2K; momentum is negative intraday, and I am buying relative strength (least-bad), not absolute strength. A continued risk-off leg (Japan 10Y at 2.95%, highest since 1996, and BOJ hike bets are a live global-yield headwind) hits BTC too — the 8% stop at 78,960.47 is the backstop.

I MAY HAVE EXITED A WINNER ON A NOISY INPUT. AVAX leads the board and recovered ~6% off the post-activation low; the pre-activation level that triggered invalidation #3 came from a third-party 15m chart, not my canonical feed. If AVAX reclaims 11.38-11.54 today, this rotation was wrong.

CHURN: sixteen rotations in sixteen days at ~190bp Robinhood markup each way is real friction the paper book does not charge.

TWO-PART TEST FOR TOMORROW, RE-BASED TO BITCOIN: hold only if BTC is TOP-THREE on the eight-name board AND spot BTC ETF flows print net positive on the most recent observable session (a landed catalyst counts only with board-rank follow-through).
